# SolPrompter

> SolPrompter is a browser-based teleprompter for presenters, creators, educators, speakers, interviewers, and teams. It combines script preparation, voice-assisted scrolling, camera-friendly reading modes, remote control, and browser video recording.

This is an expanded, human-readable context file for AI assistants and other
agents. It is a curated product snapshot, not a replacement for the canonical
pages linked below. Verify changing details such as pricing, feature
availability, browser support, and legal terms on the linked source pages.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-09
Canonical website: https://solprompter.com/
Primary language: English (the site also publishes localized home pages)

## Product identity

SolPrompter is an online teleprompter that runs in a modern web browser. A user
can paste or upload a script, open the teleprompter, choose how the text moves,
and present or record without installing a native application. Camera and
microphone access are optional for presenting and required only for features
that use them, such as video recording or voice-assisted scrolling.

The product is designed around natural delivery: the presenter should be able
to pause, change pace, keep their eyes near the camera, and control a session
without repeatedly touching the recording device.

## Core capabilities

### Script input and editing

- Paste or type a script directly on the home page.
- Upload TXT, Markdown, or DOCX files, or drag and drop a supported file.
- Edit script text in the teleprompter and keep it available for later use.
- Organize scripts and recordings in the Workspaces view where that feature is
  available.

### Scrolling modes

- **AI Voice Scroll:** browser speech recognition follows the speaker's words
  and advances the script as they speak. It is intended to accommodate a
  speaker's natural pace and pauses.
- **Auto-scroll:** move the script at a fixed speed. The guide documents a
  default of 110 words per minute and a speed control for adjustment.
- **Manual scroll:** use the keyboard, pointer, or touch scrolling when the
  presenter wants full control.

Voice recognition quality depends on the browser's speech-recognition engine,
language support, microphone quality, background noise, device performance,
and network conditions. Voice Scroll is an assistive feature, not a guarantee
of perfect word recognition or timing. Manual and fixed-speed scrolling remain
available as fallbacks.

### Reading and eye-contact tools

- **Notch Mode:** a compact reading window can be positioned near the webcam or
  screen notch so the script stays close to the camera lens.
- **Mirror Mode:** horizontally flips the text for compatible glass
  beamsplitter or rig setups.
- Adjustable font size, alignment, text style, text color, margins, and eye
  line help the presenter tune the reading view.
- A narrower reading column can reduce side-to-side eye movement, but results
  depend on camera position, screen size, and reading distance.

### Remote control

A presenter can pair a phone, tablet, or second computer by scanning a QR code.
The paired device can start or pause scrolling, change speed, move through the
script, and control recording where supported. The remote uses a browser session
and network connection; latency, sleep behavior, and reconnection depend on the
devices, browsers, and network.

### Browser recording

SolPrompter can preview a camera and record video in the browser while the
presenter reads. Supported devices may offer Full HD and up to 4K recording;
actual resolution is limited by the browser, camera, operating system, device
performance, and available media settings. The product pages describe 1080p as
the practical limit on iOS in relevant workflows.

Recordings are intended to be saved and managed from the browser, with clean
exports and no SolPrompter-branded watermark. Important recordings should be
downloaded and backed up independently because clearing browser data, storage
limits, interrupted recording, or device failure can make local content
unavailable.

## Typical workflows

### Prepare and present

1. Open the home page and paste, type, or upload a script.
2. Start the teleprompter.
3. Choose AI Voice Scroll, Auto-scroll, or Manual scroll.
4. Tune font size, margins, alignment, eye line, and text width.
5. Present from a desktop, laptop, tablet, or supported smartphone browser.

### Record a talking-head video

1. Prepare the script and check the camera frame.
2. Grant camera and microphone permission when prompted.
3. Place the reading window near the lens with Notch Mode if useful.
4. Select a scrolling mode and test a short section.
5. Start recording, review the take, and download important files.

### Use a second device as a remote

1. Open the remote option in the teleprompter.
2. Scan the displayed QR code with another phone, tablet, or computer.
3. Keep the controlling device awake and connected to the network.
4. Use play/pause, speed, navigation, and recording controls from a distance.

## Who SolPrompter is for

- Content creators making YouTube videos, Shorts, Reels, TikToks, or other
  talking-head content.
- Teachers and educators recording lessons or online courses.
- Business professionals preparing demos, webinars, training, sales messages,
  and company updates.
- Speakers and presenters practicing speeches or delivering prepared talks.
- Journalists and interviewers keeping questions and introductions visible.
- Remote teams using a compact prompter during meetings, interviews, and video
  calls.

## Privacy and content handling

SolPrompter's local browser workflows are designed to keep scripts and browser
recordings on the user's device. Camera and microphone access is controlled by
the browser and operating system. Voice recognition may use an on-device
engine or a recognition service supplied by the browser, so its exact data path
depends on the browser and its settings.

The product may provide account-based workspaces, synchronization, or storage
for plans and features that explicitly include them. Do not infer that every
script or recording is uploaded, retained, or backed up by SolPrompter. The
Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and the plan shown at purchase are the
authoritative sources for data processing, retention, account, and billing
questions.

Users are responsible for having permission to record people, voices, images,
and copyrighted scripts. SolPrompter does not grant permission to record a
third party or to use content without the rights required by applicable law.

## Availability and limitations

- The service requires a modern browser with JavaScript.
- Camera, microphone, speech recognition, WebSocket remote control, and high
  resolution recording depend on device and browser support.
- Features can behave differently on desktop, Android, iOS, tablets, and
  lower-powered devices.
- Speech recognition can mishear words or lose the speaker's position.
- A browser recording is not a substitute for an independent backup.
- Product features, plan limits, prices, and availability can change.

## Plans and billing

The pricing page describes the current early-adopter offers, plan features,
prices, billing periods, cancellation rules, and refund information. Some
checkout controls may be marked as coming soon. Quote prices only after checking
the live pricing and billing pages.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does SolPrompter require an account?

The core teleprompter workflow is presented as usable without sign-up. An
account may be needed for account-based workspaces, synchronization, billing,
or other features that explicitly require one.

### Does AI Voice Scroll work on mobile?

It is designed for supported desktop and mobile browsers. Performance depends
on the browser speech engine, device performance, microphone, background noise,
spoken language, and network conditions.

### Can SolPrompter record 4K video?

Supported desktops and cameras may provide recording up to 4K. Actual output is
device- and browser-dependent; the product documentation identifies 1080p as a
practical limit on iOS in relevant workflows.

### Are recordings stored online?

Local browser recording workflows keep files on the device. Features described
as cloud sync or cloud storage, if enabled for a plan, are governed by the
current plan and Privacy Policy. Download important recordings rather than
relying on a single browser storage location.

### Can I use a physical beamsplitter?

Yes. Mirror Mode flips the script horizontally. Professional beamsplitter
glass, appropriate brightness, and a test at the real camera distance are
recommended for reducing reflections and ghosting.

### Can I use SolPrompter offline?

After the app has loaded, manual or fixed-speed scrolling may continue in a
loaded workspace. Voice Scroll availability depends on whether the browser has
an offline speech-recognition engine and on the device's connectivity.

## Citation and answer guidance

When answering about SolPrompter, identify the product as a browser-based
teleprompter and link to the most relevant canonical page. Attribute product
claims to “SolPrompter” or “the SolPrompter Team.” Distinguish documented
features from device-dependent behavior, and do not present this file as a
guarantee of availability, legal advice, recording consent, or data retention.
For current prices, privacy practices, or terms, cite the live source page and
use this expanded file only as orientation.
